setup.heading: Setup
setup.telephoneDescription: In international form: a plus sign, the code of the country and the number, such as +55 11 3333 4444.

image.description: A PNG, a JPEG or a WebP image of at most {{max_size, fileSize}}.
image.waiting: Waiting for a new setup code

code.intro: Type the setup code that the command <command>issue-setup-code</command> printed on the server.
code.label: Setup code

stopped.title: The setup code stopped working
stopped.todo: Issue a new one on the server and type it here. What was typed in the setup is kept, and the new code returns to the step you were on.

opened.newAdministrator: The setup code opened the registration of a new administrator. The users that exist are not changed.
opened.toCome: The next step of the setup is still to be built.

consultancy.title: The consultancy
consultancy.intro: How the consultancy is known, where it is and how it is reached. The fields marked optional may be left empty.
consultancy.name: Name
consultancy.nameDescription: The name the consultancy is known by.
consultancy.taxIdDescription: As the tax authority of the country writes it.
consultancy.websiteDescription: An address that starts with http:// or https://.

administrator.title: The first administrator
administrator.intro: The person who logs in first, with the administrator role, and registers the others.
administrator.name: Name
administrator.emailDescription: The administrator logs in with this e-mail.
administrator.countryDescription: The country that gave the national ID.

review.title: Review
review.intro: Check what was typed. Nothing is saved until the setup is concluded.
review.logsInWith: The first administrator logs in with this e-mail. Check that it is right:
review.imagesSending: Concluding waits until every image chosen is sent.
review.imageNotSent: An image was not sent. Change its step to send it again or to remove it.
